title: Checklist host-owned personal assistant identity snapshot v1
description: Read-only snapshot of an existing personal assistant owned by its host, such as a Dot. Checklist creates no persona/profile catalog and does not copy or edit host personality/memory. This snapshot is not a credential, worker identity or live integration proof.

assistant_id.description: Internal stable reference for the observed host assistant, not a caller-selected profile binding or credential.

adapter_registry_id.description: Installed adapter reference; a valid registry string never enables an implementation.

host_assistant_ref.description: Opaque non-secret host identity reference. A display name or host-exported session ID alone cannot establish a verified persistent assistant identity.

verification_receipt_id.description: Receipt for actual host identity proof, not merely a signed executable or caller-supplied field. Runtime validates receipt scope/source.

display_name.description: Read-only host-provided display snapshot; never routing authority.
